name: tell-ai-monorepo
description: Monorepo for the tell-ai CLI, the @tell-ai/sdk browser-safe AI library, and the @tell-ai/web sandbox server

scripts.build: bun run --filter @tell-ai/sdk build && bun run --filter tell-ai build && bun run --filter @tell-ai/web build
scripts.lint: bun run --filter @tell-ai/sdk lint && bun run --filter tell-ai lint && bun run --filter @tell-ai/web lint
scripts.test:web: node test/test-web-backend.js && bun run --filter @tell-ai/web build && node test/test-web-sandbox.js
scripts.test: bun run test:sdk && bun run test:env && bun run test:security && bun run test:context && bun run test:stream && bun run test:mentions && bun run test:web
scripts.ci: bun run build && bun run lint && bun run check && bun run test
